location.description:
The geographic location where the data store should reside. The value can
only be one of "global", "us" and "eu".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

widget_config_id.description: The unique ID to use for the WidgetConfig. Currently only accepts "default_search_widget_config".

access_settings.allow_public_access.description: Whether public unauthenticated access is allowed.

access_settings.allowlisted_domains.description: List of domains that are allowed to integrate the search widget.

access_settings.enable_web_app.description: Whether web app access is enabled.

access_settings.language_code.description:
Language code for user interface. Use language tags defined by
[BCP47](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/bcp/bcp47.txt). If unset, the
default language code is "en-US".

access_settings.workforce_identity_pool_.description: The workforce identity pool provider used to access the widget.

homepage_setting.description:
Describes the homepage setting of the widget. It includes all homepage related settings
and configurations, such as shortcuts.

homepage_setting.shortcuts.description: The shortcuts to display on the homepage.

ui_branding.description:
Describes search widget UI branding settings, such as the widget title, logo,
favicons, and colors.

ui_settings.description: Describes general widget (or web app) UI settings as seen in the cloud console UI configuration page.

ui_settings.default_search_request_order.description:
The default ordering for search results if specified.
Used to set SearchRequest#orderBy on applicable requests.

ui_settings.disable_user_events_collecti.description: If set to true, the widget will not collect user events.

ui_settings.enable_autocomplete.description: Whether or not to enable autocomplete.

ui_settings.enable_create_agent_button.description: If set to true, the widget will enable the create agent button.

ui_settings.enable_people_search.description: If set to true, the widget will enable people search.

ui_settings.enable_quality_feedback.description: Turn on or off collecting the search result quality feedback from end users.

ui_settings.enable_search_as_you_type.description: Whether to enable search-as-you-type behavior for the search widget.

ui_settings.enable_visual_content_summar.description:
If set to true, the widget will enable visual content summary on applicable
search requests. Only used by healthcare search.

ui_settings.interaction_type.description: Describes widget (or web app) interaction type Possible values: ["SEARCH_ONLY", "SEARCH_WITH_ANSWER", "SEARCH_WITH_FOLLOW_UPS"]

ui_settings.result_description_type.description:
Controls whether result extract is display and how (snippet or extractive answer).
Default to no result if unspecified. Possible values: ["SNIPPET", "EXTRACTIVE_ANSWER"]

ui_settings.data_store_ui_configs.name.description:
The name of the data store. It should be data store resource name. Format:
'projects/{project}/locations/{location}/collections/{collectionId}/dataStores/{dataStoreId}'.
For APIs under 'WidgetService', such as [WidgetService.LookUpWidgetConfig][],
the project number and location part is erased in this field.

ui_settings.data_store_ui_configs.facet_.description: The field name that end users will see.
Registered field name. The format is 'field.abc'.

ui_settings.data_store_ui_configs.fields.description:
'The key is the UI component. Currently supported 'title', 'thumbnail',
'url', 'custom1', 'custom2', 'custom3'. The value is the name of
the field along with its device visibility. The 3 custom fields are optional
and can be added or removed.
'title', 'thumbnail', 'url' are required UI components that cannot be removed.

The template to customize how the field is displayed.
An example value would be a string that looks like: "Price: {value}".
Registered field name. The format is 'field.abc'.
The identifier for this object. Format specified above.

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.dis.description: Whether generated answer contains suggested related questions.

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.ign.description: Specifies whether to filter out queries that are adversarial.
Specifies whether to filter out queries that are not relevant to the content.

Specifies whether to filter out queries that are not answer-seeking.
The default value is 'false'. No answer is returned if the search query
is classified as a non-answer seeking query.
If this field is set to 'true', we skip generating answers for
non-answer seeking queries and return fallback messages instead.

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.ima.description: Source of image returned in the answer. Possible values: ["ALL_AVAILABLE_SOURCES", "CORPUS_IMAGE_ONLY", "FIGURE_GENERATION_ONLY"]

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.lan.description:
Language code for Summary. Use language tags defined by
[BCP47](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/bcp/bcp47.txt). Note: This
is an experimental feature.

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.max.description:
Max rephrase steps. The max number is 5 steps. If not set or
set to < 1, it will be set to 1 by default.

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.mod.description: Text at the beginning of the prompt that instructs the model that generates the answer.
The model version used to generate the answer.

ui_settings.generative_answer_config.res.description: The number of top results to generate the answer from. Up to 10.
